description: FREE. Checks a Predge signed record (predge-attest-v1) without trusting the API: payload re-canonicalises to `canonical`, sha256(canonical) == content_hash, ed25519 signature over canonical, envelope_signature when present, and that public_key is an active key in api.predge.io/.well-known/predge-keys.json (the only network call; it is cached). Works on responses from predge_settlement_risk, predge_attest, predge_sports_attest, predge_verdict, predge_get_verdict, or a bare `attestation` envelope. Param: record (the JSON, as a string).
name: predge_verify_record
title: Verify a Predge signed record (free, offline)
